title: Write 4 student onboarding email templates to boost 30-day cohort retention
description:
Write 4 actionable, friendly onboarding emails (under 140 words each) sent to bootcamp students during their first 30 days in a Zedu cohort space.

Sequence:
1. Email 1 (Day 1): 'Welcome to Your Cohort Workspace' (Finding your cohort channel, setting notifications, asking your AI study assistant).
2. Email 2 (Day 7): 'Your First Assignment & Code Review' (How to submit assignments and track instructor feedback).
3. Email 3 (Day 14): 'Joining Live Classes & Catching Up on Recordings' (Accessing integrated live sessions on low data).
4. Email 4 (Day 30): 'Milestone Check-In & Demo Day Prep' (Collaborating in study groups and project channels).

Deliver ready-to-use markdown templates in the attachment adhering strictly to live features on zedu.chat.
rationale: Provides bootcamp operators with retention-focused learner onboarding copy, directly supporting our bootcamp acquisition and satisfaction metrics.
